trial_court: Court of Additional District Judge, M
case_name: Smt. Salita Devi v. Sh. Parveen Kumar — full case name
facts_of_case: Petitioner's husband initiated proceedings against her under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. Petitioner is not available and has prayed for transfer of proceedings to a court near her residence.

legal_principles.principle: Deemed service is considered when a respondent refuses to accept notice.
legal_principles.held: In light of the fact that notice was served upon an adult member of the family, yet none has put in appearance on behalf of the respondent today, as there is deemed service of the respondent, he is ordered to be proceeded against ex parte.

legal_principles.principle: A petitioner's ability to defend themselves is considered when determining transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The Court also has further been informed that the petitioner has a 20 years old son who is dependent upon her and she has recently lost her daughter. Learned Counsel submits that in these circumstances it is extremely difficult for the petitioner to defend herself at Karsog.

outcome.final_order: Case No HMA 52 of 2017, pending in the Court of learned Additional District Judge, M, is transferred to this court.

use_for_drafting: seeking legal aid in family disputes
